dialogue_texts: The air in these woods is quite distasteful.
It's a stagnant, heavy feeling - sort of like that shrine maiden's attitude, but with none of the charm.
Transformation! Change! The forest is finally putting on its golden gown, eh?
I'm Helene Black, the herald of the harvest! Welcome to the forest's most spectacular makeover!
A makeover? I fear a very unrefined stench is overshadowing your "spectacular" season.
This "glohm" is lacking the elegance I expect from a world-ending threat.
Glohm? Is that a new type of fertilizer? I only care about the leaves turning gold!
You should slow down and appreciate the colors, whoever the heck you are.
I'm Empress Kaguya, the monarch of the People's Kingdom of Gensokyo.
I have spent eternity appreciating things far more vibrant than these rotting leaves.
If you won't move, I'll have to see if your "autumn" can endure a duel with an immortal.
A duel? Oh, you moon-folk talk so fancy!
Let's see if your magic can outshine the falling gold!
Very well. Let us see how many minutes of my eternity you can occupy.
